answer: Each identity is a vertex locking a 100-credit bond plus a 20-credit fee. Auditors plant one fable, a false claim, each epoch. Each vertex must check the source and reject the fable; auditors audit receipts. A vertex below the accuracy ledge of 90 percent over 3 epochs, or filing an unchecked receipt, loses its bond. The k-th fake vertex costs 120 plus 25 times k minus one, with a cluster surcharge, so 1,000 fakes cost 12,607,500 credits. Copied verdicts fail: a rented farm lacks receipts, so its cluster burns. An honest vertex recovers its bond after one clean epoch.
